purpose: A room is a distinct environment with its own visual grammar, interaction grammar, temporal behavior, and consequence. Shared infrastructure may handle navigation, accessibility, and persistence; it must not flatten room identity. The interaction and memory fields are design contracts, not claims that those features are already implemented.

acceptance.minimum: Every room must own at least one non-recolorable visual system, one room-specific interaction rule, and one meaningful consequence or state transition.
acceptance.recognitionTest: Hide the title and description. A returning visitor should still distinguish the room by its visual and behavioral grammar.
acceptance.accessibility: Keyboard equivalents, reduced-motion support, visible focus, sound off by default, and no required audio.
